prompt: The ISBN helper is misbehaving in production: ingest rejects ISBNs that cataloguing swears are valid, conversions between the ten- and thirteen-digit forms come out with the wrong final digit, 979-prefix titles convert when they should have no ten-digit form, and the hyphenation we show users splits publisher prefixes in the wrong place. The agreed rules are written down in docs/ — the code has drifted from them, so make the library behave the way the docs say. The tests under test/ are the reproductions we managed to write, not the whole acceptance criteria.
